required) OR CC-BY 4.0 (attribution required, given below). NONE is
CC-BY-NC, CC-BY-SA, or subject to any non-commercial restriction.

4. Species: RHINOCEROS — SUBSTITUTION, see note
   Output file: Assets/Audio/SFX_Rhino.ogg
   Source URL (sound page): https://freesound.org/people/Breviceps/sounds/535810/
   Sound title: "Indian rhinoceros (Rhinoceros unicornis)" — "Some sounds of an
   Indian rhinoceros. Recorded with mobile phone." (19 Sep 2020; duration 9.2 s)
   Author / uploader: Breviceps ("My sounds are Public Domain (CC0)")
   Licence: CC0 1.0 Universal (Creative Commons Zero, Public Domain Dedication)
   Licence URL: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
   Attribution required: NO.
   SUBSTITUTION NOTE: no recording specifically of a BLACK rhinoceros
   (Diceros bicornis) could be found under CC0 or CC-BY on Wikimedia Commons,
   freesound.org, or opengameart.org (the only genuine rhinoceros vocalisation
   under an accepted licence is this Indian-rhinoceros recording; other hits
   were horn-instrument fakes, bird calls, or speech). This file is an honest
   rhinoceros grunt/huff of a closely related species, used as a stand-in.
   Note: downloaded via the sound's freely accessible preview file (full
   downloads on freesound.org require a login); preview is the same CC0 audio.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
5. Environment: African savanna (Kenya, near Voi) — daytime birds and wind ambience
   Output file: Assets/Audio/AMB_Savanna.ogg
   Source URL (sound page): https://freesound.org/people/dkaufman/sounds/743640/
   Direct file URL: https://cdn.freesound.org/previews/743/743640_21914-hq.mp3
   Sound title: "Birds and wind at Ngutuni Lodge"
   Description on source: "The sounds of the Ngutuni Lodge gardens near Voi, Kenya.
   Recorded with Sony PCM-A10 in wide mode." (location: Kaloleni, Taita–Taveta,
   Kenya; tags: birdsong, field-recording, nature; duration 0:22.165, 48 kHz stereo WAV)
   Author / uploader: dkaufman, 26 June 2024
   Licence: CC0 1.0 Universal (Creative Commons Zero, Public Domain Dedication),
   shown on the sound page as "Creative Commons 0"
   Licence URL: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
   Attribution required: NO.
   Note: downloaded via the sound's freely accessible preview file (full
   downloads on freesound.org require a login); preview is the same CC0 audio.
   The page tags list birds and wind only (no insect tag); content was checked
   from the page description and tags, not by ear.
   Processing: ffmpeg -n -i <preview.mp3> -t 30 -af "loudnorm=I=-23:TP=-2,
   afade=t=in:st=0:d=1.5,afade=t=out:st=20.665:d=1.5" -ac 1 -ar 22050
   -c:a libvorbis -q:a 3 Assets/Audio/AMB_Savanna.ogg
   (source is 22.165 s, so -t 30 did not bite; fade-out starts at 22.165 − 1.5.)

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
6. Effect: soft body thud / bump (suitable for "player walked into a rock")
   Output file: Assets/Audio/SFX_Bump.ogg
   Source URL (sound page): https://freesound.org/people/JonasTisell/sounds/496187/
   Direct file URL: https://cdn.freesound.org/previews/496/496187_3910073-hq.mp3
   Sound title: "Light Body thud (on clothing)"
   Description on source: "A light body thud used in a project of mine. feel free to
   use for anything" (tags: body, impact, thud; duration 0:00.325, 44.1 kHz stereo MP3)
   Author / uploader: JonasTisell, 7 December 2019
   Licence: CC0 1.0 Universal (Creative Commons Zero, Public Domain Dedication),
   shown on the sound page as "Creative Commons 0"
   Licence URL: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
   Attribution required: NO.
   Note: downloaded via the sound's freely accessible preview file (full
   downloads on freesound.org require a login); preview is the same CC0 audio.
   Processing: ffmpeg -n -i <preview.mp3> -af "silenceremove=start_periods=1:
   start_duration=0.02:start_threshold=-45dB,loudnorm=I=-16:TP=-1.5,areverse,
   afade=t=in:st=0:d=0.03,areverse" -t 0.6 -ac 1 -ar 22050 -c:a libvorbis -q:a 4
   Assets/Audio/SFX_Bump.ogg
   (30 ms fade-out implemented as areverse + fade-in + areverse, so it lands on
   the true end of the clip whatever its length.)

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
VERIFICATION (2026-10-12): all four output files exist, are non-zero, and were
probed as Vorbis, mono, 22050 Hz, <= 6 s. No file is CC-BY-NC or CC-BY-SA.
Processing deviations from the brief (unavoidable, documented): (a) this
shell's ffmpeg 8.1.3 has no `silenceremove=start_periods_noise` option, so the
equivalent `silenceremove=start_periods=1:start_duration=0.4:start_threshold=-50dB`
was used; all other settings (-t 6, loudnorm I=-16:TP=-1.5, -ac 1, -ar 22050,
libvorbis) are exactly as specified.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
VERIFICATION (2026-10-13): AMB_Savanna.ogg and SFX_Bump.ogg exist and are non-zero
(116,194 bytes and 4,967 bytes). Both probed as Vorbis, mono, 22050 Hz: AMB_Savanna
22.20 s; SFX_Bump 0.25 s (under the 0.6 s limit). Both sources were confirmed CC0 on
their freesound.org sound pages on 2026-10-13. Neither file is CC-BY-NC or CC-BY-SA.
Processing notes: entry 5 uses the brief's settings unchanged (the source is shorter
than 30 s, so the output is the full 22.2 s). Entry 6 uses the brief's settings with
the silence trim as stated above; loudnorm cannot reach I=-16 on a 0.25 s clip, and
Vorbis encoding lifted the decoded true peak to about +1.6 dBTP (sample peak 0.0 dBFS).
